title: Christ the Lord Is Risen Today (Llanfair)
description: Christ the Lord Is Risen Today (Lyra) in Tonic Solfa: the solfa line by line with the words, staff notation, all 5 verses, and a piano to sing along with.
about: The words are by Charles Wesley, first published in 1739. The tune, LLANFAIR, is by Robert Williams (1817). This version of the melody and the words comes from the Open Hymnal Project.

lines: Christ, the Lord, is risen today,
Sons of men and angels say,
Raise your joys and triumphs high,
Sing, ye heavens, and earth, reply,
Fought the fight, the battle won,
Lo! the Sun's eclipse is o'er,
Lo! He sets in blood no more,
Vain the stone, the watch, the seal,
Christ hath burst the gates of hell,
Death in vain forbids His rise,
Where, O death, is now thy sting?
Once He died our souls to save,
Soar we now where Christ hath led,
Made like Him, like Him we rise,
Ours the cross, the grave, the skies,
